# Check: upstream tui-render.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-render.test.ts

## Subject
TUI rendering, resizing, and shrinkage behavior — including Termux-specific accommodations.

## Upstream test count (approx)
16 (though catalog enumerates ~8 distinct behaviors; re-enumerate when processing)

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- triggers full re-render when terminal height changes
- skips full re-render on height changes in Termux
- does not clear screen on height change in Termux
- does not clear scrollback on height change in Termux
- latest content remains visible after resize in Termux
- triggers full re-render when terminal width changes
- clears empty rows when content shrinks significantly
- handles shrink to single line

## Upstream dependencies
Component, TUI, VirtualTerminal, Terminal from @xterm/headless

## Upstream notes
Termux detected via TERMUX_VERSION env var; skips full re-render on height changes to avoid flicker. setClearOnShrink(true) enables clearing empty rows when content shrinks. fullRedraws counter tracks redraw count. LoggingVirtualTerminal captures writes for debugging.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/tui_render_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/renderer_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/render_throttle_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.
